memory_update.text: TOST is the highest-confidence pure-play public candidate for the restaurant OS node because it combines POS, payments, restaurant software, location scale and GPV-based monetization.

PAR is below the preferred USD 1B market-cap threshold at the time checked but merits exception status because its restaurant-software product suite maps tightly to enterprise restaurant POS, loyalty, ordering, operations, back-office data and payments.

VYX is slightly below the preferred USD 1B market-cap threshold at the time checked but remains relevant as a direct restaurant and retail digital-commerce infrastructure provider with a Restaurants segment.

Block should be tracked under ticker XYZ, not SQ, after the January 21, 2025 ticker change; Square food-and-beverage exposure is meaningful but diluted by Cash App, bitcoin and broader merchant activity.

OLO was a strong direct public candidate historically but is no longer US-listed after the September 2025 Thoma Bravo acquisition; private competitors such as Olo, MarketMan, 7shifts, HungerRush, TouchBistro and SpotOn may affect public-company share but are outside this US-listed candidate output.

Need a follow-up pass on restaurant chains with proprietary operating systems, such as YUM/Byte by Yum, MCD, SBUX and DPZ, because these may be customers, internal tech platforms or data/control-plane comparables rather than scarce suppliers.

node: Labor productivity, POS, payments, scheduling, inventory, and restaurant operating software
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the restaurant operating-system chokepoint. The strongest direct public exposures are vertical POS/payment platforms and restaurant-commerce software providers that sit inside daily workflows: payments, ordering, inventory, table/kitchen operations, labor/team management, reporting, loyalty and customer data. The pass excludes delisted Olo as a candidate because it was acquired by Thoma Bravo in September 2025 and ceased NYSE trading. Candidates are research leads only, not recommendations.
